name: tasklog-mcp
description: MCP server exposing the Tasklog API as MCP tools for claude.ai custom connectors. See docs/plans/P50-mcp-server.md.

scripts.pretest: node -e "try{require('./node_modules/better-sqlite3')}catch{console.log('[pretest] better-sqlite3 is not loadable on this host (likely an arm64 binary from a phone deploy). Rebuilding for host arch...');require('child_process').execSync('npm rebuild better-sqlite3 --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.test: AUTH_DB_PATH=':memory:' SESSION_SECRET='test-secret-not-for-production' node --import tsx --test src/oauth/crypto.test.ts src/oauth/middleware.test.ts src/oauth/store.test.ts src/oauth/token.test.ts src/tools/result.test.ts
